incident.fatal_message: MU shadow book receipt precedes its exchange timestamp
incident.technical_outcome: The v2 window is guaranteed to fail because it has both a missing decision and a post-start observer-generator change.

root_cause.invalid_assumption: The observer required the local post-response receipt timestamp to be greater than or equal to the venue exchange timestamp.
root_cause.observed_condition: Hyperliquid's exchange timestamp led the machine wall clock by approximately 1.5 to 1.6 seconds during twelve consecutive direct public L2 samples.
root_cause.failure_mechanism: A valid unsigned L2 response crossed the strict timestamp check, causing the report-only observer loop to publish a fault and terminate before the next decision boundary.

repair.behavior: Retain the raw local receipt timestamp, record the bounded negative clock skew, and use max(exchange timestamp, local receipt timestamp) as the causal availability timestamp.
repair.fail_closed_condition: An exchange lead greater than 5000 milliseconds still raises an actionable ValueError.

real_bounded_poll.interpretation: The late 21:00 boundary was censored rather than fabricated.

window_disposition.reason_no_replacement: The frozen v2 contract explicitly forbids replacement-window selection after failure.
window_disposition.observer_continuation_role: Descriptive prospective collection and operational verification only; it cannot repair or relabel v2.
window_disposition.live_roster_effect: MU remains outside the live roster.

recommendation.recommendation: Keep the repaired report-only observer running, preserve the v2 failure, and allow the existing finalizer to publish FAIL after the exact end boundary. Do not open a replacement interval.
recommendation.why_now: The observer fault created an unrecoverable gap inside a preregistered window, while the underlying transport collector remains useful for descriptive evidence after repair.
recommendation.evidence_reviewed: Exact exception trace, runtime status, observer and candle journals, twelve direct public L2 samples, source code, tests, and the frozen v2 contract.
recommendation.observed_problem_or_opportunity: Bounded venue/local clock disagreement was misclassified as corrupted evidence instead of conservatively normalized with explicit provenance.
recommendation.applicable_market_regime: All regimes; this is a data-transport timing defect rather than a market signal condition.
recommendation.alternatives_considered: Ignore the skew, retry forever, change the machine clock, fabricate receipt time, widen freshness thresholds, or causally normalize bounded skew and retain raw provenance.
recommendation.expected_upside: Prevents a repeated report-only observer crash without hiding raw clock disagreement or granting any execution authority.
recommendation.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Clock lead can exceed the 5-second bound; the venue timestamp can be malformed; a later source revision can still fault; the failed v2 window cannot establish parity.
recommendation.validation_completed: The exact failure was reproduced, two regressions failed before the fix and passed after it, relevant suites passed, and a real bounded poll completed.
recommendation.validation_still_required: Continued observer uptime across future boundaries and final immutable v2 failure publication after 2026-08-18T20:00:00Z.
recommendation.success_metrics: No further bounded-skew fault, raw and normalized timestamps remain reconcilable, and the finalizer publishes the exact v2 failure without missing evidence being rewritten.
recommendation.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any skew above 5 seconds, wrong source identity, duplicate/conflicting book evidence, another fatal observer exception, or a finalizer verdict inconsistent with the frozen gap.

falsifiers: A captured failure trace shows a different exception occurred before the timestamp check.
Bounded negative skew still terminates the repaired observer.
Normalized availability can precede either the exchange or local receipt timestamp.
The repaired payload changes the computed depth imbalance for the same ordered levels.
The finalizer publishes PASS despite the missing 21:00 decision or generator change.
